## Merging ADNI Data

```{r}
#| label: load-packages



library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)


```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| label: read-data
somascanraw <- read_csv("protein_raw_data/CruchagaLab_CSF_SOMAscan7k_Protein_matrix_postQC_20230620.csv")
f01_duke_uplcraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f01_duke_uplc.xlsx")
f02a_leiden_hphraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f02a_leiden_hph.xlsx")
f02b_leiden_lphraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f02b_leiden_lph.xlsx")
f03_duke_metabolonraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f03_duke_metabolon.xlsx")
f04_npiraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f04_npi.xlsx")
f05_npiqraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f05_npiq.xlsx")
f06_medhistraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f06_medhist.xlsx")
f07_bhr_baselineraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f07_bhr_baseline.xlsx")
f08_bhr_longitudinalraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f08_bhr_longitudinal.xlsx")
f09_bhr_caregiverraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/f09_bhr_caregiver.xlsx")

lifestyle_dictionaryraw <- read_excel("lifestyle_raw_data/lifestyle_dictionary.xlsx")


```

```{r}
#| label: select-respective-variables

f01_duke_uplc <- f01_duke_uplcraw |>
  select(RID, DHA, EPA, HCys, VISCODE2, EXAMDATE) |>
  arrange(EXAMDATE, .by_group = TRUE) |>  
  group_by(RID) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>  
  ungroup()


f04_npi <- f04_npiraw |>
  select(RID, NPIK, NPIKTOT, VISCODE2, EXAMDATE) |>
  arrange(EXAMDATE, .by_group = TRUE) |>  
  group_by(RID) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>  
  ungroup()
 


f06_medhist <- f06_medhistraw |>
  select(RID, MH14ALCH,MH16SMOK, VISCODE2, VISDATE) |>
  arrange(VISDATE, .by_group = TRUE) |>  
  group_by(RID) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>  
  ungroup()

```

```{r}
#| label: merge-lifestyle

datasets <- list(
  f01_duke_uplc,
  f04_npi,
  f06_medhist
)

# Convert all RID variables to the same type
datasets <- lapply(datasets, function(x) {
  x |>
    mutate(RID = as.double(RID))
})



lifestyle_sa <- reduce(datasets, full_join, by = "RID") |>
  select(RID, DHA, EPA, HCys, NPIK, NPIKTOT, MH14ALCH, MH16SMOK)



write.csv(lifestyle_sa, "lifestyle-sa.csv", row.names = FALSE)




```
